title: Switch Off
intro: For the days when your body is fine and your head is not. Work, travel, exams, a bad week.
A little movement first to give your attention somewhere to go, then five minutes of box breathing, then two minutes of long exhales to actually drop you down.

before.label: Lightheaded
before.text: Dizzy, or pins and needles in your hands or face? Stop counting and breathe normally. Never do breath holds in water or while driving.

before.label: More than a bad week
before.text: If you feel low or anxious most days, or you haven't slept properly for weeks, talk to your doctor.

exercises.name: Box Breathing
exercises.note: In 4, hold 4, out 4, hold 4. If your mind wanders, notice it and go back to the count — that is the exercise, not a failure at it.

good: Sit upright or lie down, in four, hold four, out four, hold four
Nose breathing throughout if you can
bad: Doing it with the TV on

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.note: In 4, out 8. Box breathing steadies you; the long exhale is what drops you.
